title: Beautiful and substantial
body: Heavier in the hand than I expected — feels like a piece you'd inherit. Glaze has lovely tonal variation. Would buy more.

title: Daily use champion
body: Two months in, still our favourite breakfast bowl. Easy in the dishwasher, beautiful on the table.

title: Bigger than expected
body: Beautiful piece, but the 16cm felt larger than I'd guessed from the photos. I'd order one size down for kids.

title: Will outlast every wallet I've owned
body: Bridle leather is firm at first but breaks in beautifully. Stitching is impeccable. Bought one in chocolate after six weeks.

title: Bergamot perfection
body: Bright, jammy, with the floral notes North Pine promised. Roast date was 4 days before it arrived — could not be fresher.

title: Heirloom-quality
body: Soft, weighty wool with a beautiful natural smell. Knowing it was woven by a women's cooperative made it feel even better.
